blurb: Guests experience a tandem skydive with an experienced instructor, including a scenic plane ride, freefall, and parachute ride back to the airport. The facility offers training for solo skydiving and licensing through the West Michigan Skydiving Academy. Group bookings and discounts are available, with waivers required before jumping.
